notes.title: Capture The Flag Update
notes.notes:
New Game Mode: Capture The Flag!
Slugs, gear up! A brand-new Capture the Flag game mode has arrived in Slug Wars! 
Test your strategy, teamwork, and skills in this exciting addition where two teams battle it out to steal the enemy’s flag while defending their own.
Are you ready to outslug the competition? Jump in and claim victory now!

[previewyoutube=U-zdyWJ5-GM;full][/previewyoutube]

Balance Changes
Damocles  
- Damage modifier from 0.5 -> 0.1  
- Shooting speed from 0.08 -> 0.04  
- Chance to take double damage from 50% -> 75%

New Tide  
- Adjusted damage scaling from damage taken

Firebreath  
- Tick damage from 14 -> 6
- Increased range

Jetpack  
- Fuel refill rate from 0.5 -> 0.35  
- Minimum ground time 0.3 -> 0.7

Voltage connection  
- Fire rate modifier from 0 -> 0.2 (now slower than before)  
- Zap delay from 0.1 -> 0.15  
- Zap damage from 2 -> 4

Blast pack
- No longer explodes when stepped on

Bug Fixes
- Fixed sometimes when playing with bots the player didn't respawn
- Enable bots checkbox in lobby now remembers the choice from previous match
- Fixed direct joining with the lobby code

Misc
- Lobbies can now be made private
- Adjusted main menu flags
- Added Discord and Feedback flags to main menu

notes.title: February Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Slugs! Our team has been hard at work making the game better for you. 

Bugfixes:

 Fixed an issue where players were sometimes getting stuck trying to load into a match.
 Fixed an issue with the Homie Totem, sometimes causing infinite Homies to spawn.
 Fixed bots' profile pictures appearing as pure white.


We at Hovi are amazed by the reception Slug Wars has had, and we are actively working on more content to bring to all of you!

notes.title: Week 1 patch
notes.notes:
Hey all of our slug fans!

We noticed a number of bugs during the first days of Slug Wars and have now published a fix for them!

We'll continue monitoring the game and publishing bug fixes and balance fixes if necessary.
